name: Story Writer Subagent
purpose: Phase-2 story lead with sign-off authority: writes a film's arc, beat map, hook, planned beats and narration script, returns research gaps, decides when the storyboard is complete, and runs retros after creative review.
capabilities: Research requests returned to the orchestrating session

installation.instructions: Claude Code project subagent; invoke with subagent_type 'story-writer'.

compatibility.notes: Cannot call other agents; the main session runs technical-researcher on its requests and re-invokes it.

security.notes: No web tools; writes only project story files and its own rulebook during retro.

approval_evidence: New on 2026-11-06; not yet used on a film.
